scientific_integrity: A finite exact-rational exhaustive proof covers every connected labeled simple three-uniform hypergraph through five vertices, every absent unit-weight triple, and all binary innate opinion profiles up to an exact global-complement symmetry. The six-vertex witness has an explicit rational equilibrium and an independently checked polynomial-identity proof of strict increase for every positive added-group weight.
scientific_limitations: The universal cutoff assumes homogeneous group contributions, unit weights of all existing triples and of the added triple, no pairwise-only hyperedges, and binary innate opinions.
The all-positive-added-weight formula applies only to the stated six-agent example.
The result does not classify larger hypergraphs, other projections, or arbitrary innate opinions.
Publication priority and independent validation have not been established.
title: Sharp six-agent onset of polarization increases from adding a three-person group
